Name: Evil-Merodach, King of Babylon
Summary: Evil-Merodach, king of Babylon, in the year he began to reign lifted Jehoiachin out of prison, spoke kindly to him, and set his seat above the seats of the other captive kings.
RelatedPeople: Jehoiachin, King of Judah; King Nebuchadnezzar; Jeconiah
LifeLesson: Mercy can come from the unlikeliest throne, even in Babylon.
